title: Logical software, deployment and trust
question: Where does this component run, and which boundary does a request cross?

steps.title: Logical components are not deployment instances
steps.narration: This view explains software responsibilities. It does not imply a specific cloud vendor or a provisioned resource.

steps.title: The environment selects deployment evidence
steps.narration: One logical service can have several environment-specific instances. A TEST configuration is not proof of PROD configuration, reachability, identity or installed version.

steps.title: Network reachability and authorization differ
steps.narration: A route and a token are not blanket authorization. Tenant isolation, allowed actions, secret handling and rejected requests need explicit explanation and evidence.
questions: Which identity makes the downstream query?
Which data may cross this boundary?

steps.title: Failure domains need their own viewpoint
steps.narration: A resilient design must describe capacity, timeout, failover, backup and recovery assumptions. No availability percentage or recovery time is inferred from replica icons.
